title: An incident, and whose each step is
description: The same four steps `flow-bands` draws, said the other way round. There a band names something running *alongside* the steps and does not attribute any of them; here `actor` names who performs each one. The difference is not decoration: a band's bar spans its members' extent, so an owner holding the first, second and fourth step would draw a bar straight across the third — claiming a step it does not perform. Ownership is a property of one box, not a span over several, which is why it is a field on the node.
caption: Three owners across four steps, and the handovers are the two places the lead changes. Compare `flow-bands`, where the bars accompany all four and attribute none.
